what: When the menu button is pressed, the full-screen panel bounces in from off-screen right (3000px), overshoots by 25px at 60%, then settles back 10px at 75% and 5px at 90% (1s, each step cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)). On close it pulls 20px left over the first 20%, then flies 2000px out to the right while fading, and the panel stays visible only .5s after closing before hiding — a magazine menu drawer opened and closed with animate.css bounceInRight/OutRight

options.dur: Duration of bouncing in and out (sec), default 1
options.hide: Time the panel stays visible after closing (s), default .5 — only the first half of the exit motion shows, then it hides
options.from: Right-side distance (px) where it starts entering, default 3000
options.to: Exit distance to the right (px), default 2000
options.lock: 0 means the document scroll isn’t locked while open (locked by default — fx-drawer-lock on html)
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open/close button (multiple allowed) — when opened, the element gets is-open, aria-expanded
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Pop-in panel — position (fixed inset 0) · background is up to the consuming css
options.[data-fx-part=close]: Close inside panel (optional) — add to a link inside the panel and it closes on click

note: No closing motion before the first open (the original runs bounceOutRight once when the document opens, but it is hidden so you never see it)

from.where: shared.js menu drawer (.gh-drawer — a white rounded panel inside a red panel, when opened MENU becomes a red circle ×)
